newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Myers rebuffs Lion takeover rumour.
newsitem.headline: Myers rebuffs Lion takeover rumour.

text.p: Speculation that Lion Nathan managing director Douglas Myers was selling his shareholding in the brewing company to Philip Morris Cos Inc is unfounded, a Lion spokesperson said on Wednesday.
"Douglas is not selling anything, that rumour was actually false," the spokesperson said.

Lion Nathan's share price was at one stage up 15 cents at $3.65 on Wednesday morning in a weak overall market and brokers said there were rumours Philip Morris was staging a full or partial takeover of the company.
"People are saying that Philip Morris has interest in Doug Myers' stake in Lion," said one broker who declined to be named.

But the Lion spokesperson said Myers had rebuffed the suggestion. "We got hold of Douglas on holiday and it wasn't true. Douglas is not offloading a whole lot of shares so there isn't any truth in the rumour," she said.
Lion shares had eased to $3.55 by 0100 GMT on volume of 1.53 million. They have climbed from a recent low of $3.32 on December 19. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
